# multi-agent-development-workbench

> A local, provider-independent workbench for routing and supervising Claude,
> Codex, Grok, and API-backed coding agents through shared workflows.

spec-first: doc/arch is the source of truth — run `speckit status` then `speckit next` and read the spec before writing any code.

## Start Here

- [Repository guide](AGENTS.md): project structure, commands, gates, and contribution rules
- [Project status](docs/project/STATUS.md): delivered baseline, known gaps, and ordered roadmap
- [Human overview](README.md): product experience and architecture
- [Constitution](doc/arch/memory/constitution.md): non-negotiable design and governance principles
- [Product overview](doc/arch/functional/product-overview.md): actors and end-to-end flow

## Current State

- Run `make context` before relying on this snapshot.
- Features 001–009 are on `main` (latest: issue #15 / PR #23, merge `709ec20`).
- Next ready product increment:
  [issue #16](https://github.com/RenatoTadeuFigueiredo/multi-agent-development-workbench/issues/16),
  OpenRouter provider and cost controls; then #17 Workbench ACP server.
- [Specification](doc/arch/sdd/009-add-real-time-vs-code-workflow-controls-that-show-routing/spec.md): VS Code control-room requirements
- [Decision](doc/arch/adr/0010-add-real-time-vs-code-workflow-controls-that-show-routing.md): thin protocol client (no orchestration in TypeScript)
- [Executable scenarios](doc/arch/specs/features/add-real-time-vs-code-workflow-controls-that-show-routing.feature): Gherkin acceptance contract
- [Workflow executor](doc/arch/sdd/008-execute-configurable-multi-agent-workflows-that-resolve/spec.md): Feature 008 daemon runtime
- [MCP decision](doc/arch/adr/0008-central-mcp-lifecycle-and-tool-permissions.md): central gateway (Feature 007)
- [Encrypted storage decision](doc/arch/adr/0002-encrypted-local-session-storage.md): key lifecycle, deletion, and export
- [Local protocol](doc/arch/contracts/workbench-local-protocol.yaml): versioned command, reply, event, and error envelopes
- [Protocol semantics](doc/arch/domain/local-protocol-semantics.md): preconditions, idempotency, retries, and replay
- [Session lifecycle](doc/arch/statecharts/session-lifecycle.md): legal controls, uncertainty, and deletion transitions

## Speckit Workflow

Run `speckit status`, then execute only the phase from `speckit next`.
The lifecycle is `specify` → `clarify` → `plan` → `tasks` → `analyze` →
`implement`. Use `speckit validate` before commits, `speckit verify` for
Gherkin bindings, `speckit spec score` for corpus health, and `speckit missing`
for the ranked advisory queue. Never edit `doc/.specify/` directly or bypass
the guard.
